text:
fran: short thread 1 1 proposing a slightly different approach for sidebar IA + breadcrumbs. goal: minimize url churn for normal nav, but make it trivially easy to share an exact "view" (including which groups are open). sketch: https://figma.com/file/small-rail-view (frames 1-5).
oscar: good framing. my worry: users expect clicking a breadcrumb to match what they see in the rail. if the rail is compacted, clicking breadcrumb should expand that group and focus the item.
fran: agreed. UX pattern: breadcrumbs always point to canonical paths (/w/:ws/nav/:group/:item). click handler expands target group (if collapsed), focuses item, and does a soft center scroll. avoid jumping to top of page.
priya: about sharing: make default copied links canonical (no UI state). add a secondary action "Copy exact view" in the three-dot menu that serializes minimal UI state into a short fragment. avoid query params for cleanliness.
henry: engineering note: fragments are ideal for client-only state. we can use a compact serializer + base64 to keep fragments tiny. e.g. #v=ey9ncnA6W10=
priya: accessibility nits: when a fragment restores and expands groups, emit an aria-live message like "Navigation restored: Teams expanded" and move focus programmatically to the first restored element. ensure this is optional for screen reader users to avoid verbosity.
fran: keyboard semantics: group headers get role=button, tabindex=0, aria-expanded state. Space/Enter toggles. Pin action should be aria-pressed. leave pin state out of canonical path; keep it in history.state unless user chooses "Copy exact view".
oscar: small UX request: when a copied fragment is loaded, show a subtle chip at top-left: "This link includes open sections" with an ellipsis menu to strip UI state or dismiss. helps privacy.
henry: implementation sketch:
```
// on normal nav
history.replaceState({ open: ['teams-42'] }, '', `/w/${ws}/nav/teams/42`)

// when user picks "Copy exact view"
const fragment = btoa(JSON.stringify({ open: ['teams-42'], pinned: ['teams-42'] }))
copyToClipboard(`${location.origin}${location.pathname}#v=${fragment}`)
```

priya: copy strings: primary menu item = "Copy link", secondary = "Copy exact view (includes open sections)". toast = "Link copied" / "Exact view link copied". tone should be clear and concise.
fran: decision for MVP: 1) canonical deep links via path; 2) ephemeral UI = history.state + sessionStorage fallback; 3) add explicit "Copy exact view" that uses encoded fragment; 4) breadcrumb clicks expand + focus target with smooth scroll; 5) aria-live + optional verbosity flag for SR users; 6) subtle banner when loading fragment.
ux-bot: preview: rail-view-exact -> staging at 2026-03-20T10:00Z :rocket: (link: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/rail-view-exact)
oscar: i'll prototype the breadcrumb expand behavior and the banner.
priya: i'll add a11y checklist and update copy strings.
henry: i'll build the fragment helper and add a small encoder util that prunes PII.
fran: thanks team 1 will update figma + post PR checklist.
